AVIATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
